notes:
CRM notes (shorthand):
- Product: mid-market B2B SaaS — in-app assistant + smart doc search + realtime rerank.
- Trial behavior: 2 weeks hosted API; ~12k sessions, 1.4M tokens total. Good signal for production patterns.
- POC metrics (observed on hosted trial): avg QPS 3.6 sustained, 95th pct QPS bursts to ~18 QPS during US morning, typical concurrency ~10, peak concurrency ~58 during promo.
- Token profile: avg request tokens ~110, avg response tokens ~420; token mix est: chat 48%, embeddings 30%, rerank/summarize 22%.
- Cost sensitivity: strong — procurement target is <$0.50 per 1k prompt tokens (net), looking for >25% reduction vs hosted baseline with dedicated + quantization.
- Latency SLOs: p95 <350ms for embeddings (short), p95 <450ms chat (100–600 tokens). p99 requirement flagged for prioritization for paid tier.
- "We need predictable monthly unit cost — can't tolerate 3x variance across spikes" — Head of Product (call 2026-02-26).
- Security: required SOC 2 + SSO, want KMS integration and audit log retention 1 year; possible data residency requirement (US-only) for a subset of PII.
- Network: VPC peering + private egress preferred; asked for flow diagram (SE action).
- Dedicated sizing: initial worksheet suggests 3-5 A100-equivalent GPUs depending on quantization/latency targets; conservative ask is 4 GPUs with autoscale to 6 for 30% headroom.
- Forecasting ask: Redwood asked to provide token-level cost model broken down by workload (chat vs embeddings) + recommended batch sizes per model variant.
- Next: finalize dedicated sizing (worksheet), complete SOC2 paperwork, procurement call w/ finance 2026-03-10.
- Misc links: pricing deck + workbook in Drive; security FAQ referenced in thread-9u2b3-sales-pricing.
